card.name: Just before street names and numbers
card.fires_on: Words that come right before a street name or number, such as 'on', 'at', 'down', 'cross', 'NW' or a space before an address number. Seen in street addresses and directions.

modes.label: Prepositions before a street
modes.description: Small words like on, at, down or cross that lead into a named street or avenue.
modes.example: It’s location<< on>> Fifth Avenue between 50th and

modes.label: Inside an address
modes.description: Direction letters or a space just before a street number or ordinal street name.
modes.example: The Miami Amtrak Station is located in the industrial suburb of Hialeah on<< NW>> 32nd Ave, just north

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: A blank space just before a number that starts an address or a chemical name.

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict ordinal street numbers like Fifth, Sixth or Seventh next.
card.plain: It fires where a street name or address is about to come, especially numbered streets like Fifth Avenue.
